# Syed Saad Ur Rahman

> Computer science engineer building AI-driven products and full-stack SaaS for production. Based in Hyderabad, India. Contributing engineer on a Guinness World Record team in agentic AI; winner of the NGIT Project Expo 2025.

## About
- Name: Syed Saad Ur Rahman
- Role: CS Engineer, AI Builder, Full-Stack Developer
- Education: B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering, Neil Gogte Institute of Technology (NGIT), 2024–2027; Diploma in Computer Science, Pallavi Engineering College
- Location: Hyderabad, India
- Focus: Applied AI, agentic systems, full-stack SaaS

## Selected work (live)
- Cracked AI (https://crackedai.in): the AI placement coach for Indian engineers. Adaptive skill diagnostic (DSA, aptitude, OS, DBMS, CN, verbal), AI mock interviews (Technical + HR) with instant scoring, a live "Friday" voice coach for spoken interview practice, and company packs for TCS NQT, Infosys SP, and Wipro NLTH. Stack: LLM, Voice AI, React, FastAPI, Supabase.
- Van Lavino (https://van-lavino.vercel.app): a full café/restaurant SaaS. QR-code table ordering, Razorpay payments, realtime order updates, a staff order dashboard, and a multi-branch admin panel. Stack: React, TypeScript, Supabase, Razorpay.
- TenderIQ (https://tender-iq-mu.vercel.app): an agentic AI system for automated tender evaluation that pipelines unstructured procurement documents through an LLM reasoning layer to surface structured insights. Stack: Python, LLM, PDF pipeline.

## Other projects
- FasalDoc: computer-vision model for early plant disease detection from a single leaf image.
- TruthLens: multi-modal misinformation detection (LLM reasoning, digital forensics, rPPG-based deepfake detection).
- Construction Co. website: production corporate website shipped to a paying client.
